consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer reading avatar.carried_items[]; it asks 'which item occupies the wielded slot and which items occupy the worn slots?' and shows them.
scope: only the character's own carried items: the wielded item plus the worn-slot items
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, whose body enumerates raw world state ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and inventory, tagging each emitted item with a location ('wielded'|'worn'|'inventory') — emitting the ground-truth equipped lists, not an engine-computed predicate or filtered display proxy.
divergence: Wield a combat knife and wear a backpack: if the export sourced from the nearby ground stack (map::i_at) or dropped the worn list, the paperdoll would show an empty wield slot or no worn backpack, diverging from the true equipped state.
